profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company headquartered in Dublin, trading under the ticker ACN. Its website describes the company as embracing change to create what it calls 360 degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, and says it works across industries and around the world using emerging technologies and human ingenuity.

The site highlights several AI related themes. It describes Accenture Construct as a new global business bringing together advisory, engineering, delivery, digital and AI to orchestrate capital projects from strategy through execution and operation. Other material on the site discusses redesigning work and skills so people and AI work together, notes that global executives enter 2026 with confidence after two years of rapid AI acceleration alongside gaps standing in the way of scale and value, describes AI pushing power demand beyond grid limits and a shift by data center developers to a power-first strategy, and frames cyber resilience as a strategic mandate in an AI driven threat landscape.

The company's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its SEC filing record shows CIK 0001467373.
